title: Unit Event — Lead With Courage and Kindness — Episode8 Guiding Sound

meta.Event Outline: Honami considers Mr. Shindo's question of what kind of music she aspires to, but finds herself feeling restless as she's unable to find an answer. Meanwhile, Mr. Shindo discusses Leo/need with the president of Solis Records.

rows.Line: A few days later
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: One more... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
My stick...
Ow...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You have a blister.
Let's stop here for today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I want to continue...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can keep going.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I don't want to stop here...
I know everyone will regret it if we're unable to put on a performance we're happy with...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm really happy.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You're happy...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Compared to the others, I'm really not that great a performer. Also, I can't write songs like Ichika and Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been trying to make up for those things by putting our schedules together, editing our videos and such...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But even so, it's always bothered me that my music skills are lacking...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel like I'll finally be able to make real contributions to our performances.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I want to keep going...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If my performance can be of help to the others, I want to master it...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then... Let's continue for just thirty more minutes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is it. We're performing for Mr. Ota today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo said we should try to relax, but I'm still pretty nervous.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, but we should be fine...
I mean, we practiced a ton and had all those lengthy discussions just for this day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I agree with Ichika...
We did everything we could to prepare for today. All that's left now is for us to execute.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, we should be fine.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hiya, girls♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Rin? Oh, you're all here?
Did you need something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You're performing for the president of the record company soon, right? We were wondering how you're all feeling. Nervous?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Do you think you'll be able to put on a good performance?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, we're nervous...
But... We should do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We all carry these wonderful feelings with us as we play. So, if we can clearly present them through our performance...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we will. I'll make sure of that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, we should all feel confident about how we're going to perform.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Looks like we got all worked up over nothing...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Looks like it... We'll be looking forward to seeing the new and improved you perform, Honami.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
I'll put my phone over in the corner so you can listen to us play.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You will?! Thanks, Ichi!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Also, isn't it almost time?
Good luck, girls.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience.
We're looking forward to seeing you perform today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
We're also looking forward to playing!

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Haha. You certainly sound excited.
Again, I apologize for making you do this today.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: But I've genuinely been looking forward to your performance, so I'm hoping for something outstanding.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Do you by chance happen to be ready?
If so, then we'd like for you to play a song for us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we're ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here we go, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've been wanting to help everyone like this for the longest time...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (With their musical aspirations...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Moving people's hearts, cheering them up, bringing them together...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Those are all very wonderful wishes, and I love how they all care so much about our music...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which is why I want to help them achieve those goals. I want to give them all the support I can...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I made a stark realization while training for this day...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Just helping them won't be enough.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Someone has to pull us in the right direction and keep us acting as a single unit... To ensure that our feelings, our performances, resonate in the best way possible.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which is why...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I can't just provide support...
I have to...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to lead us...!)

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Well now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Here we go...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The first verse...
We talked about how it encapsulates our desire to move people's hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's designed to captivate our audience...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And that's why...it starts with you, Shiho!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes, we're doing well...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Next, the second verse...
This song's feel begins to slowly make a transition.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Now we're trying to show empathy for those in pain... We want them to know that we're there to help...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's about reassuring them, so we need a kind and delicate touch...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The others can just focus on what they're doing. I'll handle everything else...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Through my drumming, I'll relay to the others what we should be feeling and how we need to be playing... All in order to put on the best performance we possibly can.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The chorus is coming up.
Get ready, Ichika...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is incredible... Singing has never felt so easy.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Our performance and feelings are melding into one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My singing is going to bring everyone together... It's like the others are pushing me to make my hopes and wishes come true...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which means I can do this now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Alright, Ichika... Go!)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
(Talk about a nice surprise...
They're still a little rough around the edges, but they've clearly improved.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (It's not that any of them have made any dramatic discoveries or improvements.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (They've just figured out how to take what they have now, unite and drive it to the limit.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (A band isn't a band if there's only one person involved. Every member has to believe in the cause. Only then can the whole exceed the sum.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
(However, achieving that isn't easy.
You have to build trust and forge deep bonds.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (Ms. Hinomori is the only one with real experience working with professional artists, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (The four of them already have these unbreakable bonds. They genuinely believe that they can best any other band in that.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (Which means... That's their secret weapon.)

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I like their sound...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Sir...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I can see why you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Nice work! That was a wonderful performance, and an outstanding expression of how you all feel.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Now I'm very much looking forward to how you do after you debut...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I'll be sure to keep you in mind for that festival.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I also enjoyed your performance very much.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You in particular did an excellent job of leading your band, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's all because of you, Mr. Shindo...
I can't thank you enough for what you did...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: No, I was just doing my job...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Ah, speaking of which...
I brought some good news with me today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good news?
Oh, tell us! Please!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Your wait is over...
Your debut date has been set.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-O-Our...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our big debut?!?!?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
D-D-D-Did you hear that?!
It's really happening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, at long last...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wow, we're really debuting...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I struggled to figure out what I want to aspire to as a professional musician, and what I can do for this band... But I have my answers now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I want to help the others.
And in order for me to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not only going to support them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm going to lead Leo/need forward.)
